caption: The drawing portrays a single, ornate pitcher centrally positioned on a plain background. The pitcher is depicted in shades of blue and has a bulbous body adorned with intricate, raised patterns including swirls and floral motifs. The base features a series of vertical ridges, adding texture to the lower part of the vessel. The handle is a curved, thick band attached at the upper side and rim of the pitcher, also shaded in blue. The mouth of the pitcher is wide with a prominent spout, and the lip is delicately undulated to match the ornate style of the body. The background is plain, with a soft beige color within a hand-drawn rectangular border. The artist's signature, "FUMAGALLI," appears in the lower-left corner inside the border. There are a few small discolorations and spots on the paper, mainly in the upper left quadrant.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
